messages:
alex_sales: Hey team — new POC with NovaHealth. Procurement just pinged me: they need a signed DPA, SOC2 evidence, and a POC order form for 30 days. They asked for a 30-seat, 500k-token cap trial with a private endpoint. Can legal/security confirm the path and any blockers?

maya_solutions: Adding details from the solution side: 30 seats, 30 days, 500k token cap, expected start 2026-04-12. They want VPC private endpoint + KMS integration. Also asked for sample order form lines for procurement.

kevin_security: Quick checklist from Sec: 1) Completed security questionnaire from NovaHealth; 2) SOC 2 Type II report or AICPA bridge; 3) Confirm whether PHI will be sent — if yes, we need BAA; 4) For VPC/KMS we need exact subnet/IP allowlist and customer KMS ARN details.

sarah_legal: Thanks — on DPA/SLA redlines: customer submitted a few asks: data deletion on termination (30 days), uptime SLA tightened to 99.5% and higher liability cap. Our stance: we can accept deletion clause with a short verification window, propose SLA at 99.9% for POC (production SLA can be negotiated), and keep liability cap limited to fees paid in the last 12 months. I'll prepare redlines.

alex_sales: Procurement also says they need PO issued before we execute DocuSign. Will they accept PO + DocuSign concurrently? Their billing contact is billing@novahealth.com and PO net30 is requested.

procurement_bot: New purchase request created: PR-9921 for NovaHealth POC. Attach: requested PO, billing contact, and internal cost center.

kevin_security: If they're planning to send PHI to a hosted private endpoint we must require the BAA. For on-prem or air-gapped installs, different legal/ops path — flagging @sarah_legal for BAA text.

sarah_legal: Acknowledged. I'll add a BAA addendum option and a DPA redline. Routing: propose DocuSign envelope with two required signers: (1) NovaHealth procurement lead, (2) Redwood Legal. For exec-level approval (liability changes) we may need an exec sig after legal signs. @alex_sales who is their exec contact?

alex_sales: Their procurement lead is @jordan_procure and exec approver is likely @linda_cfo. I'll ping them for PO + confirm signature path.

maya_solutions: For the order form, here's a quick draft to drop into DocuSign (please review legal):

```
Line item: Redwood Inference POC - 30 seats - 30 days
SKU: POC-30-30d
Usage cap: 500,000 tokens (overage rate: $0.015/1k tokens)
Price: $2,500 (one-time POC fee)
Billing: Net 30 upon invoice
Notes: Private endpoint and KMS integration included for duration of POC; additional charges may apply for custom network setup.
```

sarah_legal: That order form looks fine as a starting point. I'll insert the redline placeholders for DPA/BAA and the SLA paragraph. Also will add an approval checkbox for accepting the BAA.

kevin_security: For KMS integration we should list required encryption specs and key rotation expectations. I'll draft a short appendix for the security questionnaire response.

alex_sales: Procurement insisted on a copy of SOC2 before PO approval — they're waiting on that doc to release the PO. Does Security have an ETA to share SOC2 artifacts with a redacted attestation?

kevin_security: We can share the SOC2 Type II summary and an auditor letter within 24 hours; full report under NDA. I'll prepare the package and mark it shared to billing@novahealth.com and cc: jordan_procure.

handoff-bot: DocuSign envelope created: /esign/NovaHealth-PO-1968123456. Status: draft. Assigned signers: jordan_procure (customer), sarah_legal (redwood).

alex_sales: Great — I'll chase Jordan for PO and Linda for exec approval. Once PO is in, we'll confirm dates. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

sarah_legal: I'll upload redlines to the shared folder and post link here when ready. Expect a doc by EOD today.

maya_solutions: FYI — if they require on-prem to keep PHI, that will change timeline and costs. Flagging to sales to align expectations.

alex_sales: Noted. I'll flag that in the client call. Will update thread when PO or SOC2 arrives.

procurement_bot: Reminder: internal procurement hold set on PR-9921 until SOC2 received.

kevin_security: Uploaded SOC2 summary to secure share, sent to billing@novahealth.com.

alex_sales: Confirmed receipt from NovaHealth procurement. They said they'll route PO today. Closing for now, will reopen if anything else pops up.
